problem.title: Travel has to change.
problem.body: Combustion vehicles consume fossil fuels, generate emissions and require significant industrial production. Soleva explores another path: reusing an existing vehicle, converting it to electric, producing its energy locally through solar power and sharing these learnings with the public.

new_start.title: A new beginning
new_start.body: Despite the fire that ravaged the workshop and took Sunny, the first solar van, the Soleva adventure continues. The van's safety systems worked perfectly, proving the reliability of the design. After inspiring so many people during the Swiss tour, the team refuses to let this dream die. A new solar van is in preparation, driven by the team's passion and the community's support.

cards.carbon_desc: Soleva compared its prototype with electric vehicles and conventional diesel vans on the European market. Its comparison reports 81% lower CO₂ emissions than a conventional diesel van when retrofitting and charging entirely with solar power, including the embodied energy of the batteries and electric motor.
cards.circular_desc: The retrofit extends the life of a 1987 vehicle rather than building a new one, avoiding the impact of industrial production.
cards.solar_desc: The energy of the journey is produced directly by the sun thanks to the on-board photovoltaic panels.
cards.awareness_desc: Beyond the technology, Soleva shares its learnings with the public, schools and institutions.

hero.title: The Soleva adventure
hero.subtitle: A project born from a passion for nature and engineering, driven by a team of Swiss engineers.

about.mission_body: Promote solar electric mobility and sustainable travel by transforming an old vehicle into an electric van powered by photovoltaic solar energy.
about.vision_body: Inspire society towards a more sustainable transition in mobility, energy, travel and vehicle design.
about.story_body: Soleva started in 2021 when Curdin Wüthrich, a physics graduate from EPFL, and four friends - all passionate about nature and sustainability - decided to tackle a challenge: convert an old 1987 diesel van into a 100% solar-powered electric camper. The idea came from their shared experience as nature photographers, traveling in fossil-fuel vans while advocating for the environment.
about.team_subtitle: A team of engineers and enthusiasts, supported by dozens of volunteers.
about.members_subtitle: A team of engineers and enthusiasts, supported by dozens of volunteers.
about.press_subtitle: National media coverage in Switzerland and beyond.

mentorRoles.marc: Founder of ICARE, President of Impact Living

about.education_body: Soleva trains current and future engineers, takes part in events about renewable energy and educates people about sustainable travel. The project promotes slow travel and demonstrates how low-tech solutions can be integrated into a small home on wheels.
about.today_body: More than 13 people involved, 8 student projects, over 30 media appearances, 11 sponsors and partners, more than CHF 120,000 raised and over 130 crowdfunding contributors: Soleva’s published overview of its first prototype.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how Soleva handles your personal data, in accordance with the Swiss FADP and the European GDPR.
privacy.controller_body:
Association Soleva
Responsible: Curdin Wüthrich
Avenue de Cour 19
1007 Lausanne
Switzerland
Email: info@soleva.org
Phone: +41 77 420 74 40
privacy.data_body: We only collect data necessary for the proper functioning of the site and, with your consent, usage statistics via Google Analytics (Google LLC, USA).
privacy.purposes_body: Your data is used to operate the website, respond to your contact and donation requests, and improve our services. Marketing purposes are only pursued with separate consent.
privacy.analytics_body: We use Google Analytics 4 in consent mode. No analytics data is collected before your explicit consent. Data may be transferred to and processed in the United States.
privacy.retention_body: Server logs are retained for security purposes for a maximum of seven days and then deleted. Data needed as evidence is retained until the incident has been clarified. Statutory archiving obligations apply to contact requests.
privacy.rights_body: You have the right to access, modify, delete, and port your personal data, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Contact us at info@soleva.org. Aggregated browsing data (Google Analytics) does not allow identifying an individual person.
privacy.logs_body: The server may record the page and file accessed, date and time, amount transferred, request outcome, browser, operating system, referring page, IP address and internet provider. This information is used for security and investigating abuse.
privacy.social_body: When you visit our social media pages, the operators’ terms and privacy policies apply. We process information you share with us on those platforms to respond to your messages.
